import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INV = 570000004L;
    static final int MAXBITS = 20;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        long[][] p = new long[6][6];

        // Read the input matrix; only first 6 rows and columns matter
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                if (i < 6 && j < 6) {
                    p[i][j] = (val * INV) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        // For the case n < 6, fill the missing entries
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = n; j < 6; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    p[i][j] = 1;
                } else {
                    p[i][j] = 0;
                    p[j][i] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        // Force n = 6 for the rest of the algorithm
        n = 6;

        // Generate all 20 permutations (first 3 increasing, last 3 increasing)
        int[][] permsA = new int[20][3];
        int[][] permsB = new int[20][3];
        int t = 0;
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < 6; i1++) {
            for (int i2 = i1 + 1; i2 < 6; i2++) {
                for (int i3 = i2 + 1; i3 < 6; i3++) {
                    int[] rest = new int[3];
                    int idx = 0;
                    for (int x = 0; x < 6; x++) {
                        if (x != i1 && x != i2 && x != i3) rest[idx++] = x;
                    }
                    permsA[t] = new int[]{i1, i2, i3};
                    permsB[t] = new int[]{rest[0], rest[1], rest[2]};
                    t++;
                }
            }
        }

        // All 6 permutations of (0,1,2)
        int[][] ordPerms = {
            {0, 1, 2}, {0, 2, 1}, {1, 0, 2}, {1, 2, 0}, {2, 0, 1}, {2, 1, 0}
        };

        int sizeBm = 1 << MAXBITS;
        long[] bmA = new long[sizeBm];
        long[] bmB = new long[sizeBm];
        long[] f = new long[sizeBm];

        int mask18 = 1 << 18;
        for (int i = 0; i < mask18; i++) {
            long prob1 = 1, prob2 = 1;
            // Compute probs from the 18 bits (6 players * 3 positions)
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                    int bit = j * 3 + k;
                    if ((i & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                        prob1 = (prob1 * p[j][k]) % MOD;
                        prob2 = (prob2 * p[j][k + 3]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prob1 = (prob1 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k])) % MOD;
                        prob2 = (prob2 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k + 3])) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }

            int bm1 = 0, bm2 = 0;
            // Check each permutation for first set (A)
            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ot++) {
                boolean ok = false;
                for (int[] ord : ordPerms) {
                    boolean ok2 = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < 3; jj++) {
                        int val = permsA[ot][ord[jj]];
                        int loc = val * 3 + jj;
                        if ((i & (1 << loc)) == 0) {
                            ok2 = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok2) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) bm1 |= (1 << ot);
            }
            // Check each permutation for second set (B)
            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ot++) {
                boolean ok = false;
                for (int[] ord : ordPerms) {
                    boolean ok2 = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < 3; jj++) {
                        int val = permsB[ot][ord[jj]];
                        int loc = val * 3 + jj;
                        if ((i & (1 << loc)) == 0) {
                            ok2 = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok2) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) bm2 |= (1 << ot);
            }

            bmA[bm1] = (bmA[bm1] + prob1) % MOD;
            bmB[bm2] = (bmB[bm2] + prob2) % MOD;
        }

        // SOS DP on f (copy of bmA)
        System.arraycopy(bmA, 0, f, 0, sizeBm);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXBITS; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < sizeBm; mask++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f[mask] = (f[mask] + f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute final answer
        long sm = 0;
        int fullMask = sizeBm - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeBm; i++) {
            sm = (sm + (bmB[i] * f[fullMask ^ i]) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        long ans = (1 + MOD - sm) % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
